definition: means treatment for which the insured person has to stay in a hospital for more than 24 hours for a covered event.
plain: Treatment where you occupy a hospital bed for more than 24 hours for a covered condition.
whyItMatters: Almost every benefit in a health policy — room rent, surgeon's fees, ICU, pre- and post-hospitalisation — is triggered by in-patient care. Outpatient treatment usually is not covered at all unless you have bought an OPD benefit separately.
